name: semester-navigator
description: Set up a private semester plan from course materials, choose the next task, and get source-based study and writing support.

interface.shortDescription: Set up your semester and choose your next task.
interface.longDescription: Import course materials, save a student workspace, and plan the next useful action. Browser connections, verified reminders, and private Sites are optional. Includes a separate browser-only starter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Semester Navigator to set up my semester from my syllabus and show what I should do next.
